comment: pickup: the piece opens with a half-bar anacrusis (\partial 2). Bars count from the first full bar, so the score's 'Agitato' starts at bar 14 and 'Tempo primo' at bar 43.
tempoMap: the MIDI plays the ppp ending in strict time; a ritardando over bars 59-60 and the fermata on the last chord.
Easy keeps tempo factor 1.0: after thinning the Agitato (bars 14-42) charts 1.6 notes/s, one note every 625 ms on beats 1 and 3, sparser than the Lento's eighths (2.0 notes/s).
